# 2/22/2025: TPL ParkServe

```{r}

### PART 1: LOAD DATA & SET CRS

# Read the RecLands (master) and TPL parks (new) datasets
master <- st_read("Z:/Data/PilotArea/MasterPolygon/RecLandsPilot.gpkg")
new    <- st_read("Z:/Data/PilotArea/tpl_parks_5p.gpkg")

# Transform both datasets to the same coordinate reference system (EPSG:32633)
master <- st_transform(master, crs = 32633)
new    <- st_transform(new, crs = 32633)


### PART 2: OVERLAP ANALYSIS & NON-INTERSECTING EXTRACTION

# --- Overlap Matrix Calculation ---
# Create a 2x2 matrix to store intersection counts between master and new datasets.
overlap_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
rownames(overlap_matrix) <- c("master", "new")
colnames(overlap_matrix) <- c("master", "new")

# Count intersections (any intersection regardless of overlap area)
overlap_matrix["master", "new"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(master, new)) > 0)
overlap_matrix["new", "master"]  <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, master)) > 0)
# Self-intersections
overlap_matrix["master", "master"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(master, master)) > 0)
overlap_matrix["new", "new"]       <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, new)) > 0)

cat("Initial overlap matrix (any intersection):\n")
print(overlap_matrix)

# Disable the s2 geometry engine for projected coordinate systems
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# --- Extract Non-Intersecting Features based on 5% Overlap Threshold ---

# Add a unique identifier to the new dataset (if not already present)
new <- new %>% mutate(new_id = row_number())

# Calculate intersections between new features and master polygons,
# then compute the overlapping area for each intersection.
new_master_intersections <- st_intersection(new, master) %>%
  mutate(intersect_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  group_by(new_id) %>%
  summarise(total_overlap = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Calculate the area of each new feature and compute the overlap ratio.
new_with_overlap <- new %>%
  mutate(new_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  left_join(new_master_intersections, by = "new_id") %>%
  mutate(overlap_ratio = as.numeric(total_overlap) / as.numeric(new_area))

# Select features with an overlap ratio of at least 5%
new_intersect <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(overlap_ratio >= 0.05)

# Features with less than 5% overlap (or no overlap) are considered non-intersecting.
new_nonint <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(is.na(overlap_ratio) | overlap_ratio < 0.05)

# --- Visual Check using tmap ---
tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(master) +
  tm_polygons(col = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5, border.col = "blue", title = "RecLands (Master)") +
tm_shape(new_intersect) +
  tm_polygons(col = "green", alpha = 0.5, border.col = "darkgreen", title = "TPL Parks (>=5% overlap)") +
tm_shape(new_nonint) +
  tm_polygons(col = "orange", alpha = 0.5, border.col = "red", title = "TPL Parks (<5% overlap)")


### PART 3: PREPARE TPL PARKS TO MATCH RecLands SCHEMA

# Adjust master OWNER_TYPE values if needed
master$OWNER_TYPE[master$OWNER_TYPE == "Fee"] <- "Local Government"

# Rename TPL (new_nonint) columns to align with RecLands schema,
# preserving the unique TPL identifier as TPL_ID.
# Note: new_nonint represents TPL parks that are not intersecting or intersecting at less than 5%
new_nonint_renamed <- new_nonint %>%
  mutate(
    OWNER_TYPE = case_when(
      Park_Owner == "" ~ "Local Government",
      Park_Owner %in% c("CITY", "CNTY", "DIST") ~ "Local Government",
      Park_Owner == "NONPROFIT" ~ "Non-profit",
      Park_Owner %in% c("PRIV", "UTIL") ~ "Private",
      Park_Owner == "ST" ~ "State"
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(
    TPL_ID  = ParkID,      # Rename ParkID to TPL_ID for clarity
    MA_NAME = Park_Name,   # Rename Park_Name to MA_NAME
    ACRES   = Park_Size_,  # Rename Park_Size_ to ACRES
    SRC_DATE= Park_DateA,  # Rename Park_DateA to SRC_DATE
    OWNER   = Park_Local   # Rename Park_Local to OWNER
  )

# Define the subset of columns to select from the TPL dataset.
new_select_cols <- c("TPL_ID", "MA_NAME", "ACRES", "SRC_DATE", "OWNER", "OWNER_TYPE")

# Select only the specified columns from the renamed TPL data and override fields
# to match the RecLands schema.
new_nonint_selected <- new_nonint_renamed %>%
  select(all_of(new_select_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    GIS_SRC      = "tpl_parkserve",                              # Mark the origin as tpl_parkserve
    Creator      = "youngjaewon",                                # Set Creator for TPL rows
    CreationDate = as.POSIXct("2025-02-22 12:55:00"),             # Set CreationDate for TPL rows
    SRC_DATE     = as.character(as_date(SRC_DATE))              # Convert SRC_DATE to character format
  )


### PART 4: COMBINE DATASETS & WRITE OUTPUT

master_updated <- bind_rows(master, new_nonint_selected)

# Write the updated RecLands dataset to a GeoPackage
st_write(master_updated, "Z:/Data/PilotArea/MasterPolygon/RecLandsPilot20250222.gpkg")


```


# 2/24/2025: SampsonPark_Parcels 

```{r}

### PART 1: LOAD DATA & SET CRS

# Load the base RecLands dataset (expanded layer) as 'master' and the new Sampson dataset as 'new'.
master <- st_read("Z:/Data/PilotArea/MasterPolygon/RecLandsPilot20250222.gpkg")
new <- st_read("Z:/Data/PilotArea/Sampson/original/SampsonPark_Parcels.shp")

master <- st_transform(master, crs = 32633)
new <- st_transform(new, crs = 32633)


### PART 2: OVERLAP ANALYSIS & NON-INTERSECTING EXTRACTION

# --- Overlap Matrix Calculation ---
# Create a 2x2 matrix to store overlap counts between the base layer and the new dataset.
overlap_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
rownames(overlap_matrix) <- c("master", "new")
colnames(overlap_matrix) <- c("master", "new")

# Count overlaps between master and new
overlap_matrix["master", "new"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(master, new)) > 0)
overlap_matrix["new", "master"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, master)) > 0)

# Self-overlap counts
overlap_matrix["master", "master"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(master, master)) > 0)
overlap_matrix["new", "new"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, new)) > 0)

# Print the overlap matrix for review
print(overlap_matrix)

# Disable the s2 geometry engine (useful for projected coordinate systems)
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)


# --- Extract Non-Intersecting Features based on 5% overlap threshold ---

# Add a unique identifier to the new dataset if not already present
new <- new %>% mutate(new_id = row_number())

# Calculate intersections between new features and master polygons
# and compute the overlapping area for each intersection
new_master_intersections <- st_intersection(new, master) %>%
  mutate(intersect_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  group_by(new_id) %>%
  summarise(total_overlap = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Calculate the area of each new feature and compute the overlap ratio
new_with_overlap <- new %>%
  mutate(new_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  left_join(new_master_intersections, by = "new_id") %>%
  mutate(overlap_ratio = as.numeric(total_overlap) / as.numeric(new_area))

# Select features with an overlap ratio of at least 5%
new_intersect <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(overlap_ratio >= 0.05)

# Features with less than 5% overlap (or no overlap) are considered non-intersecting
new_nonint <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(is.na(overlap_ratio) | overlap_ratio < 0.05)


### PART 3: PREPARE NEW DATA & MERGE WITH BASE LAYER

# Rename and reformat the new dataset to match the base layer's schema.
new_nonint_renamed <- new_nonint %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    MA_NAME = PARK,
    ACRES   = CALC_ACRES,
    OWNER   = CURRENT_OW,
    geom   = geometry  # This ensures the geometry column is labeled as expected.
  )

# Select only the necessary columns and add additional fields.
select_cols <- c("MA_NAME", "ACRES", "OWNER")
new_prepared <- new_nonint_renamed %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(select_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    GIS_SRC = "sampsonpark_parcels",
    Creator = "youngjaewon",
    CreationDate = as.POSIXct("2025-02-24 16:38:00")
  )

# Merge the new non-intersecting records with the base master dataset.
master_updated <- dplyr::bind_rows(master, new_prepared)

# Write the updated layer to disk.
st_write(master_updated, "Z:/Data/PilotArea/MasterPolygon/RecLandsPilot20250224.gpkg")

```

# 3/17/2025: Kiwanis Park

    SRC_DATE= Park_DateA,  # Rename Park_DateA to SRC_DATE

  )

# Select only the specified columns from the renamed TPL data and override fields
# to match the RecLands schema.
kiwanis_selected <- kiwanis_renamed %>%
  select(all_of(new_select_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    GIS_SRC      = "tpl_parkserve",                              # Mark the origin as tpl_parkserve
    Creator      = "youngjaewon",                                # Set Creator for TPL rows
    CreationDate = as.POSIXct("2025-03-17 12:12:00"),             # Set CreationDate for TPL rows
    SRC_DATE     = as.character(as_date(SRC_DATE))              # Convert SRC_DATE to character format
  )

master_updated <- dplyr::bind_rows(master, kiwanis_selected)

st_write(master_updated, "Z:/Data/PilotArea/MasterPolygon/RecLandsPilot20250317.gpkg")


# Select columns from AircraftFlying to Boardwalk, then drop amphitheaterstage_count.
selected_cols <- master_updated %>%
  select(AircraftFlying:Boardwalk) %>%
  select(-amphitheaterstage_count)

# Count occurrences of "Yes" (ignoring NA and "No")
yes_count <- sum(unlist(selected_cols) == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
yes_count


```

new <- st_make_valid(new)

### PART 2: OVERLAP ANALYSIS & NON-INTERSECTING EXTRACTION

colnames(overlap_matrix) <- c("master", "new")

overlap_matrix["new", "master"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, master)) > 0)

# Self-overlap counts
overlap_matrix["master", "master"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(master, master)) > 0)
overlap_matrix["new", "new"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, new)) > 0)

# Print the overlap matrix for review
print(overlap_matrix)

# Disable the s2 geometry engine for projected coordinate systems
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# --- Extract Non-Intersecting Features based on 5% overlap threshold ---

new <- new %>% mutate(new_id = row_number())

# Calculate intersections between new features and master polygons
# and compute the overlapping area for each intersection
new_master_intersections <- st_intersection(new, master) %>%
  mutate(intersect_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  group_by(new_id) %>%
  summarise(total_overlap = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Calculate the area of each new feature and compute the overlap ratio
new_with_overlap <- new %>%
  mutate(new_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  left_join(new_master_intersections, by = "new_id") %>%
  mutate(overlap_ratio = as.numeric(total_overlap) / as.numeric(new_area))

# Select features with an overlap ratio of at least 5%
new_intersect <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(overlap_ratio >= 0.05)

# Features with less than 5% overlap (or no overlap) are considered non-intersecting
new_nonint <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(is.na(overlap_ratio) | overlap_ratio < 0.05)


### PART 3: PREPARE TPL PARKS TO MATCH RecLands SCHEMA

# Rename new_nonint columns to align with RecLands schema,
# Note: new_nonint represents polygons that are not intersecting or intersecting at less than 5%
new_nonint_renamed <- new_nonint %>%
  rename(
    MA_NAME = NAME,   # Rename NAME to MA_NAME
    geom = geometry
  )

# Define the subset of columns to select from the new dataset.
new_select_cols <- c("MA_NAME", "OWNER")

# Select only the specified columns from the renamed TPL data and override fields
# to match the RecLands schema.
new_nonint_selected <- new_nonint_renamed %>%
  select(all_of(new_select_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    GIS_SRC      = "open_space_wake_county",                              # Mark the origin
    Creator      = "youngjaewon",                                # Set Creator
    CreationDate = as.POSIXct("2025-03-17 18:38:00")             # Set CreationDate 
  )


### PART 4: COMBINE DATASETS & WRITE OUTPUT

master_updated <- bind_rows(master, new_nonint_selected)

# Write the updated RecLands dataset to a GeoPackage
st_write(master_updated, "Z:/Data/PilotArea/MasterPolygon/RecLandsPilot20250318.gpkg")

```

```{r}


# Read master and new datasets
master <- st_read("Z:/Data/PilotArea/MasterPolygon/RecLandsPilot20250320.gpkg")
new <- st_read("Z:/Data/PilotArea/Spatial/LWCF_poly.shp")

# Transform both datasets to the same coordinate reference system (EPSG:32633)

master <- st_make_valid(master)
new <- st_make_valid(new)

### PART 2: OVERLAP ANALYSIS & NON-INTERSECTING EXTRACTION

# --- Overlap Matrix Calculation ---
# Create a 2x2 matrix to store overlap counts between the master and new datasets.
overlap_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
rownames(overlap_matrix) <- c("master", "new")
colnames(overlap_matrix) <- c("master", "new")

# Count overlaps between master and new using st_intersects
overlap_matrix["master", "new"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(master, new)) > 0)
overlap_matrix["new", "master"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, master)) > 0)

# Self-overlap counts
overlap_matrix["master", "master"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(master, master)) > 0)
overlap_matrix["new", "new"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, new)) > 0)

# Print the overlap matrix for review
print(overlap_matrix)


# --- Extract Non-Intersecting Features based on 5% overlap threshold ---

# Add a unique identifier to the new dataset if not already present
new <- new %>% mutate(new_id = row_number())

# Calculate intersections between new features and master polygons
# and compute the overlapping area for each intersection
new_master_intersections <- st_intersection(new, master) %>%
  mutate(intersect_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  group_by(new_id) %>%
  summarise(total_overlap = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Calculate the area of each new feature and compute the overlap ratio
new_with_overlap <- new %>%
  mutate(new_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  left_join(new_master_intersections, by = "new_id") %>%
  mutate(overlap_ratio = as.numeric(total_overlap) / as.numeric(new_area))

# Select features with an overlap ratio of at least 5%
new_intersect <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(overlap_ratio >= 0.05)

# Features with less than 5% overlap (or no overlap) are considered non-intersecting
new_nonint <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(is.na(overlap_ratio) | overlap_ratio < 0.05)


### PART 3: PREPARE NEW Dataset TO MATCH RecLands SCHEMA

# Rename new_nonint columns to align with RecLands schema,
# Note: new_nonint represents polygons that are not intersecting or intersecting at less than 5%
new_nonint_renamed <- new_nonint %>%
  rename(
    MA_NAME = ELEMENTNAM,   # Rename NAME to MA_NAME
    geom = geometry
  )

# Define the subset of columns to select from the new dataset.
new_select_cols <- c("MA_NAME")

# Select only the specified columns from the renamed TPL data and override fields
# to match the RecLands schema.
new_nonint_selected <- new_nonint_renamed %>%
  select(all_of(new_select_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    GIS_SRC      = "LWCF_poly",                              # Mark the origin
    Creator      = "youngjaewon",                                # Set Creator
    CreationDate = as.POSIXct("2025-04-11 15:28:00")             # Set CreationDate 
  )


### PART 4: COMBINE DATASETS & WRITE OUTPUT

master_updated <- bind_rows(master, new_nonint_selected)

# Write the updated RecLands dataset to a GeoPackage
st_write(master_updated, "Z:/Data/PilotArea/MasterPolygon/RecLandsPilot20250410.gpkg")


```

# Set tigris to return spatial features (sf) objects

nc_counties <- counties(state = "NC", cb = TRUE, year = 2023)

tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(triad_counties) +
  tm_polygons()

st_write(triad_counties, "Z:/Data/Triad/CountyBoundary/CountyBoundary.gpkg")

# 5/19/2025: TPL ParkServe

```{r}
### PART 1: LOAD DATA & SET CRS

# Read the RecLands (master) and TPL parks (new) datasets
master <- st_read("Z:/Data/Triad/MasterPolygon/RecLandsTriad20250515.gpkg")
new    <- st_read("Z:/Data/Triad/tpl_parks_triad.gpkg")

# Transform both datasets to the same coordinate reference system (EPSG:32633)
master <- st_transform(master, crs = 32633)
new    <- st_transform(new, crs = 32633)


### PART 2: OVERLAP ANALYSIS & NON-INTERSECTING EXTRACTION

# --- Overlap Matrix Calculation ---
# Create a 2x2 matrix to store intersection counts between master and new datasets.
overlap_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
rownames(overlap_matrix) <- c("master", "new")
colnames(overlap_matrix) <- c("master", "new")

# Count intersections (any intersection regardless of overlap area)
overlap_matrix["master", "new"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(master, new)) > 0)
overlap_matrix["new", "master"]  <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, master)) > 0)
# Self-intersections
overlap_matrix["master", "master"] <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(master, master)) > 0)
overlap_matrix["new", "new"]       <- sum(lengths(st_intersects(new, new)) > 0)

cat("Initial overlap matrix (any intersection):\n")
print(overlap_matrix)

# Disable the s2 geometry engine for projected coordinate systems
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# --- Extract Non-Intersecting Features based on 5% Overlap Threshold ---

# Add a unique identifier to the new dataset (if not already present)
new <- new %>% mutate(new_id = row_number())

# Calculate intersections between new features and master polygons,
# then compute the overlapping area for each intersection.
new_master_intersections <- st_intersection(new, master) %>%
  mutate(intersect_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  group_by(new_id) %>%
  summarise(total_overlap = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Calculate the area of each new feature and compute the overlap ratio.
new_with_overlap <- new %>%
  mutate(new_area = st_area(.)) %>%
  left_join(new_master_intersections, by = "new_id") %>%
  mutate(overlap_ratio = as.numeric(total_overlap) / as.numeric(new_area))

# Select features with an overlap ratio of at least 5%
new_intersect <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(overlap_ratio >= 0.05)

# Features with less than 5% overlap (or no overlap) are considered non-intersecting.
new_nonint <- new_with_overlap %>% filter(is.na(overlap_ratio) | overlap_ratio < 0.05)

# --- Visual Check using tmap ---
tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(master) +
  tm_polygons(col = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5, border.col = "blue", title = "RecLands (Master)") +
tm_shape(new_intersect) +
  tm_polygons(col = "green", alpha = 0.5, border.col = "darkgreen", title = "TPL Parks (>=5% overlap)") +
tm_shape(new_nonint) +
  tm_polygons(col = "orange", alpha = 0.5, border.col = "red", title = "TPL Parks (<5% overlap)")


### PART 3: PREPARE TPL PARKS TO MATCH RecLands SCHEMA

# Rename TPL (new_nonint) columns to align with RecLands schema,
# preserving the unique TPL identifier as TPL_ID.
# Note: new_nonint represents TPL parks that are not intersecting or intersecting at less than 5%
new_nonint_renamed <- new_nonint %>%
  mutate(
    OWNER_TYPE = case_when(
      Park_Owner == "" ~ "Local Government",
      Park_Owner %in% c("CITY", "CNTY", "DIST") ~ "Local Government",
      Park_Owner == "NONPROFIT" ~ "Non-profit",
      Park_Owner %in% c("PRIV", "UTIL") ~ "Private",
      Park_Owner == "ST" ~ "State"
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(
    TPL_ID  = ParkID,      # Rename ParkID to TPL_ID for clarity
    MA_NAME = Park_Name,   # Rename Park_Name to MA_NAME
    ACRES   = Park_Size_,  # Rename Park_Size_ to ACRES
    SRC_DATE= Park_DateA,  # Rename Park_DateA to SRC_DATE
    OWNER   = Park_Local   # Rename Park_Local to OWNER
  )

# Define the subset of columns to select from the TPL dataset.
new_select_cols <- c("TPL_ID", "MA_NAME", "ACRES", "SRC_DATE", "OWNER", "OWNER_TYPE")

# Select only the specified columns from the renamed TPL data and override fields
# to match the RecLands schema.
new_nonint_selected <- new_nonint_renamed %>%
  select(all_of(new_select_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    GIS_SRC      = "tpl_parkserve",                              # Mark the origin as tpl_parkserve
    Creator      = "youngjaewon",                                # Set Creator for TPL rows
    CreationDate = as.POSIXct("2025-05-19 10:43:00"),             # Set CreationDate for TPL rows
    SRC_DATE     = as.character(as_date(SRC_DATE))              # Convert SRC_DATE to character format
  )


### PART 4: COMBINE DATASETS & WRITE OUTPUT

master_updated <- bind_rows(master, new_nonint_selected)

master_updated <- st_transform(master_updated, crs = 4326)

# Write the updated RecLands dataset to a GeoPackage
st_write(master_updated, "Z:/Data/Triad/MasterPolygon/RecLandsTriad20250519.gpkg")


```
